category_title: Students in vocational settings who struggle with professional norms like punctuality
minimal_context: The student is arriving late to their long-day vocational program at the TAFE college and needs to complete the daily sign-in routine.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is past 8:30am. I also noticed you didn't sign off yesterday when you left.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah, I forgot to sign off.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please try to remember next time. Why are you arriving late this morning?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I couldn't get here on time today. I'm just really tired.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You still need to make sure you get here when the program starts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm tired from moving house, I couldn't help being late.
